neighbours.label: The ' pe' piece of pebble/pebbles/pebbly, vs synonyms for small stones and other words that start with ' pe'
fire: The children collected shiny pebbles along the edge of the lake.
Each step crunched on the pebbles that lined the garden path.
Waves rolled a single smooth pebble back and forth on the shore.
The fish tank had a layer of coloured pebbles on the bottom.
We skimmed flat pebbles across the pond until the sun went down.
A pebble-strewn track led down to the old harbour.
The riverbed was pebbly and cold under our bare feet.
She kept a striped pebble from the beach on her desk.
quiet: The children collected shiny shells along the edge of the lake.
Each step crunched on the gravel that lined the garden path.
Waves rolled a single smooth stone back and forth on the shore.
The fish tank had a layer of coloured sand on the bottom.
We ate roasted pecans on the porch until the sun went down.
A muddy track led down to the old harbour past a peat bog.
The riverbed was rocky and cold under our bare feet.
She kept a striped pencil from the office on her desk.

predictions: Pebble words reach 0.5-0.8 on ' pe'; gravel/stones and other pe- words (peat, pecan, pelican) stay under 0.1.
notes: Card: ' pe' in pebbles x13, also ' b' in boulder, -st in stepping-stones, peat. Probe: pebbly 0.697, pebbles 0.580; boulder 0.054, peat 0.024, pelican 0.005, pesto 0.005, stones 0.056, rock 0.064. ' pebbles' splits ' pe'+'bb'+'les'.
